craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. Comma→semicolon (crown stated, Name released). Rejected: capitalising 'name' — plain kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Past strand and phase, his mark is the Temple's crown — Dhūrjaṭi's;
his very Name: what prop besides bears fruit for brooders?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

reads_against.argmap: Of past-guṇa-yoga's chief meditation-object, of Dhūrjaṭi: even the name. → Dhūrjaṭi's name alone outdoes all meditations; other supports are fruitless.
c1_essence: Independent trident power in all cosmic tasks; Dhūrjaṭi's name outdoes meditations.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)

l2.plain_english: Of the chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga, of Dhūrjaṭi — even the name: for meditators, by meditations, what fruit by other supports?
l2.sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

reads_against.t1: What fruit from other supports for those who meditate — even the name of Dhūrjaṭi, chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga?
